name: gearbox
description: Per-prompt model and effort for Claude Code: Haiku sessions shift models, other sessions keep their model and get the right effort, tool-heavy work goes to cheap subagents, runs of reads on long conversations go to Haiku, an optional orchestrator keeps the main conversation to planning, runs the work in one long-lived lane per model and splits a request of independent parts across several agents at once, and a live readout shows every agent's model.

code_effort.title: Coding effort
code_effort.description: Effort for writing code: every code turn runs at least at it, small edits included; answers and explanations follow their difficulty. Default xhigh; max is the most thorough, the slowest and the costliest; Anthropic suggests medium for Opus 5.5 if you prefer faster, cheaper turns. Also settable with /gearbox settings.

steer.title: Steer sessions not on Haiku
steer.description: On sessions running another model, keep that model and set each turn's effort and handoffs. Off leaves those sessions alone apart from the readout.

escalate.title: Hand work up to a stronger model
escalate.description: On a steered session below the model the work calls for (Sonnet, for work the rules put on Opus), hand that work to a subagent on the stronger model: on (code, reviews, costly work and subtle questions), code (only work that changes files, and reviews), or off (everything stays on the session's model). Also settable with /gearbox escalate.

navigator.title: Browser navigator
navigator.description: Model of the subagent that clicks through browser checks and only collects evidence; the main model then analyzes it. Sonnet is the default (as fast as Haiku in a side-by-side test, and steadier); Haiku is cheaper.

strict.title: Strict hand-offs
strict.description: During a browser-check or long-command step, keep the main conversation from doing the work itself so a subagent does it; also binds a plain subagent to the step's model and effort. Also settable with /gearbox strict.

log.title: Debug log
log.description: Write what gearbox decides, and what each request sent, to ~/.claude/gearbox/logs/<session>.jsonl: off, on, or full (also the first 200 characters of each prompt). Also settable with /gearbox log.

band.title: Band above the prompt
band.description: The band above the prompt box: GearBox, the live model·effort and what it does, subagents, cost and why, then a row per running subagent, with Panel, Log and Settings. Bands other mods draw stay under it. Also settable with /gearbox band.

agent_hooks.title: Your hooks for subagents
agent_hooks.description: Run your own UserPromptSubmit and Stop hooks for subagents as the main conversation gets them, which Claude Code does not: a subagent's task goes through your UserPromptSubmit hooks (what they print goes to it), and when it stops through your Stop hooks (a block or feedback sends it back to work). Also settable with /gearbox hooks.

orchestrator.title: Orchestrator
orchestrator.description: The main conversation only plans, briefs and reviews; the work runs in lanes, one long-lived subagent per model, each started at the top effort and lowered per job. Off by default. Also settable with /gearbox orchestrator.

orchestrator_model.title: Orchestrator model
orchestrator_model.description: Model of the main conversation while the orchestrator is on. Also settable with /gearbox orchestrator-model.

orchestrator_effort.title: Orchestrator effort
orchestrator_effort.description: Effort of the main conversation while the orchestrator is on. Also settable with /gearbox orchestrator-effort.

orchestrator_agents.title: Orchestrator parallel agents
orchestrator_agents.description: While the orchestrator is on, the most agents a request of independent parts goes out to at once, from 1 to 6; 1 turns the fan-out off. The orchestrator decides from the survey whether a request splits and into how many, never more than this. Also settable with /gearbox orchestrator-agents.
